description: A meter one slot wide showing the level of the signal patched into it
menu: Voltage Meter Mode Selection — reads the bar as a voltage meter, over 0 to 1v, 0 to 5v, 0 to 10v, 0 to 20v, 0 to 50v, 0 to 100v, -1 to 1v, -5 to 5v or -10 to 10v voltages
VU Meter Mode Selection — reads the bar as a VU meter, with VU meter mode RMS timing or VU meter mode PEAK HOLD timing
